mcp.intro: I-MCP ngumgangatho ovumela iiarhente ze-AI (Claude, Cursor, iinkqubo zakho) ukuba zisebenze neenkonzo zangaphandle. Iarhente enethokheni ingakhangela kwaye ifunde iposi yakho nezinto eziqhotyoshelweyo (kuphela ezo zihlolwe yi-antivirus), ijonge abaqhagamshelwana nekhalenda, kwaye ilungiselele iidrafti. Ingatshintsha kwaye ithumele imiyalezo kuphela ukuba uyayivumela. Yonke into eyenziwa yiarhente iyabhalwa.
